image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a small, slender snake coiled in an S-shape on a textured surface of mossy stone or concrete. The snake has a uniform reddish-brown to pinkish-tan coloration with a smooth, slightly glossy skin texture. Its head is indistinct from the body, featuring a blunt, rounded snout. No limbs are present. The background consists of grey stone with patches of green moss and white lichen.
